hero_sub: Live product first: Peaks (Most Replayed, chat spikes, CCV), the member portal, and the production pipeline. Below is what we are hardening next.

now.headline: Peaks depth
now.description: Stronger YouTube, Twitch, and Kick Peaks flows through stage, compose, and publish in the member portal.

now.headline: Portal UX polish
now.description: Customer portal and staff portal UX aligned with the Pavilion / Business Rocket design system.

next.headline: More Short templates
next.description: More in-portal job tools for common streamer Short workflows beyond the Peaks homepage offer.

next.headline: Publish coverage
next.description: Broader direct-publish coverage and clearer per-platform status in the app.

next.headline: Managed add-ons
next.description: Clearer ordering of HeyGen, Imagen, and other Managed-tier extensions from the job spec.

next.headline: Scheduling polish
next.description: Better scheduled publish controls for operators running multi-platform calendars.

future.headline: Mobile review
future.description: Review jobs and approve outputs from mobile without a full native app rewrite.

future.headline: Shoppable extensions
future.description: Optional shoppable tagging as a job-spec extension for customers who order it.
